_comment: Electrophysiology: UCM MEG and UniRoma EEG, each as raw band-passed signals and as orthogonalised envelopes. Paths accept $ENV_VARS; $DATA_DIR is set in .env.

UCM_AAL._comment: Source-reconstructed MEG, AAL. n_epochs = 38: fixed number of epochs per subject (fdt_eeg gec_diagnostics a3).

UniRoma._comment: Channel-space EEG (30 channels): no SC, seeded random initialisation.

_preprocessing: Defaults: raw signals (variant 'alpha'). The sweep entries with envelope + orthogonalize give the 'alpha_env_orth' variant. The two options are set together in one grid entry, not as two lists, so the mixed variants (env only, orth only) are not computed.

linear_hopf._comment: freqs_path: one value (Hz) per node; '{subject}' in the path selects a file per subject. TODO: compute.

_fitting: check_every 100, as neuronumba's FitGEC: tol is the relative improvement between two checks, so checking every 10 iterations stops ~10x earlier, and any increase between checks (one noisy step) stops the fit.
_study3: lab_default: the lab's default learning rates per model, outlined in the Study 3 figures (must be a cell of the eps_fc x eps_fs grid; null: not shown).

sweep._comment: Study 2, raw signals: fix eps_fc, vary eps_fs (and the reverse)
Raw signals: models at their default settings
Orthogonalised envelopes: models at their default settings

Updated fit (config.PROCEDURES 'updated': weighted step, FC + FS_A stopping rule), raw signals: the Study 2 grid. Studies 2 and 3 show it as models of their own (legacy_updated, network_updated); Study 4 compares it with the original fit.
